args.query: OpenTelemetry tracing for FastAPI with console or in-memory span exporter

results.title: OpenTelemetry SDK spans captured with InMemorySpanExporter
results.summary: Record nested spans, links and attributes with the OpenTelemetry SDK, then assert on the finished spans via InMemorySpanExporter and a SimpleSpanProcessor, fully offline under pytest.

results.title: FastAPI with async SQLAlchemy 2 on aiosqlite, tested offline with per-test in-memory DBs
results.summary: A FastAPI app using AsyncSession and async_sessionmaker on aiosqlite, tested with httpx.AsyncClient over ASGITransport, overriding the session dependency with a fresh in-memory database for each test.

results.title: FastAPI endpoints cached with cashews in-memory backend
results.summary: FastAPI routes backed by a cashews mem:// cache with key templates, TTL and explicit invalidation, tested fully offline through httpx ASGITransport.

results.title: SQLModel + FastAPI CRUD with in-memory SQLite
results.summary: Full CRUD API with SQLModel table models, separate create/update schemas and a session dependency overridden for tests.

results.title: FastAPI login with argon2-cffi hashing and rehash checks
results.summary: A form-based FastAPI login that verifies argon2id hashes without leaking which users exist, and transparently upgrades outdated hashes on successful login, tested offline with TestClient and an in-memory store.

results.title: FastAPI endpoints rate limited with slowapi, tested with TestClient
results.summary: Add per-route and per-API-key rate limits to FastAPI with slowapi, then test 429 behavior offline with TestClient and the in-memory store.

results.title: FastAPI background tasks + dependency overrides
results.summary: FastAPI BackgroundTasks for post-response work, with dependency_overrides to swap services in tests.

results.title: FastAPI dependency_overrides tested offline with httpx ASGITransport
results.summary: Override FastAPI dependencies (including nested ones) and drive the app in-process with httpx.ASGITransport, no network and no running server.

results.title: FastAPI lifespan state tested with httpx ASGITransport and asgi-lifespan
results.summary: A FastAPI app that opens a SQLite connection in its lifespan, then test it offline through httpx ASGITransport, with asgi-lifespan running startup and shutdown.

results.title: FastAPI request ids in structlog contextvars, tested with capture_logs
results.summary: Pure ASGI middleware binds a request id into structlog contextvars, echoes it in an X-Request-ID header, and is tested offline with TestClient and structlog.testing.capture_logs.
